also: hang a picture on the wall
put it up on the wall

phrases.latin: Pictūram tuam in pariete suspendāmus, ut omnēs videant.
phrases.english: Let’s hang your picture on the wall, so everyone can see it.

phrases.latin: mē tabulā sacer vōtīvā pariēs indicat ūvida suspendisse potentī vestīmenta maris deō
phrases.english: the sacred wall, with its votive tablet, shows that I have hung up my wet clothes to the mighty god of the sea

sources: Lewis & Short: suspendo · Lewis & Short: paries
